title: German football’s fan membership figures continue to climb | Bundesliga
content: The Bundesliga and Bundesliga 2 are home to some incredible fan membership figures. The Bundesliga and Bundesliga 2 continue to have some of the best supported clubs in the game, with recent figures showing an increase in club memberships in both leagues and Bayern Munich announcing a new world record total. Bayern confirmed at their 2025 annual general meeting at the start of November that they had reached 432,500 members to make them the largest sports club in the world by membership - an achievement president Herbert Hainer said "we can be proud of". It's a huge increase on the 400,000 number they announced to mark the club's 125th anniversary in February, which took them level with Benfica of Portugal, and the total of 382,000 at the previous year's AGM. Dr Hubertus Hess-Grunewald, president and chairman of the supervisory board at Werder, meanwhile, also announced in 2025 when the club reached 64,000 members - of which over 1,000 have been members for life - that "We are incredibly proud of how our membership numbers have grown.

title: The German Football Association: key facts and figures
content: # The DFB - the world’s largest sports association. Everything you should know about the German Football Association: the key facts and figures about the world’s largest sports association. The German Football Association (DFB) has more than **7.7 million members** (as of the beginning of 2025) and as such is the world’s largest sports association:. The **men’s national team** has won the World Cup four times (in 1954, 1974, 1990 and 2014) and the European Championship three times (in 1972, 1980 and 1996). **A fun fact:** one of the 15 most clicked-on people on the DFB’s website is a Pole - the others being nine members of the German women’s team and five members of the German men’s team. The **DFB clubs with the most members** are **FC Bayern Munich**, which is the world’s largest sports club with 382,000 members, ahead of **Borussia Dortmund** (218,500, world’s number 5) and second Bundesliga team **Schalke 04** (190,400, world’s number 6). 125 years of the DFB.

title: Top 5 Clubs with the Most Paid-up Members - Finance Football
content: ## Top 5 Clubs with the Most Paid-up Members in the World. Benfica recently became the sports club with the most members in the world, having dethroned the German club Bayern Munich by around 10 thousand members. The Portuguese team is on its way to the unprecedented milestone of 400,000 members, with around eight thousand remaining: in January it had just over 392,000 members. The 400,000 member mark could be surpassed in the coming months, taking into account the rate of 3,000 members per month that the red-blacks manage to gather in their membership base. Bayern, which until recently boasted of being the team with the most members, moved up to second place in the ranking with 382,000 members. Being a member gives you the chance to get a ticket to watch home games at the Allianz Arena, which is always packed, and the German team has taken advantage of this to expand its membership base. # Top 5 Clubs with the Most Paid-up Members.
